title: TIP RED 1193 red journey: Cmd-N, Ctrl-`, then one burst of real key events (Cmd-D, a line, Cmd-D, a line) posted before the new terminals exist: each line runs in its own new pane
why: TIP RED 1193 (STATUS 1202, cmux-ad 10:48Z): on feat 5097a275a876 (cmux18, whole host, real key window) the line typed at once after the first Cmd-D and the line after the second Cmd-D both ran in the second new pane, 2 of 3 rounds. Keys typed for a terminal that is still being made must reach that terminal. Needs a real key window (run.py --whole-host on a CuaDriver-granted mini); lines are typed at once, never after the creation hold. The burst (smoke_burst: one debug.key sequence, real events through the app's queue) puts each line's keys in the queue before its terminal exists, so the hold-and-replay path runs every round (cmux-ad 11:05Z); the per-key debug.key calls of the smoke gate reach the new terminal directly when it is already focused.
source: the dogfood smoke gate's step 'Cmd-D twice fast' (journeys/dogfood/smoke-dogfood.json), cut to the failing sequence
